overclaims: Both figures show spending at a large multiple of revenue, which fits 'far more than they earn.'
Microsoft's 10-Q equity-method loss implies OpenAI lost about $11.5B in July to September 2025, far more than its reported revenue run.
checks.note: H1 R&D was about 1.56 times H1 revenue. The inferred Q3 loss has no corresponding Q3 revenue figure in the evidence, so both figures cannot establish large spending-to-revenue multiples. Disclose the missing Q3 comparator and the 27% stake assumption behind the $11.5B inference. The supported outcome matches the reviews, but these comparisons overstate the evidence.
